newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Life deal seen closing by January.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Life deal seen closing by January.

text.p: Bankers Life Holding Corp said Wednesday the previously announced merger with Conseco Inc is expected to occur by early January.
In August, Conseco said it planned to merge with Bankers Life by acquiring the outstanding shares of the company that it does not own, in return for about $117 million in Conseco common stock.
In the intended merger, each of the 4.7 million outstanding shares of Banker Life stock not already owned by Conseco would be converted into the right to receive $25 in Conseco common stock.
Completion of the transaction is subject to review by the Securities and Exchange Commission of the information to be submitted to shareholders of Bankers Life.
